exhaust.route: header round the front of the engine, silencer on the right

gearLever.kind: foot shift pedal pivot, left of the frame

N_rpm.rest: zero reading at 210 deg (bottom left) on the dial; the scale runs 240 deg clockwise as the rider sees it, so a full reading is -240 deg about the axis (right hand)

N_speed.rest: zero reading at 210 deg (bottom left) on the dial; the scale runs 240 deg clockwise as the rider sees it, so a full reading is -240 deg about the axis (right hand)

notes: Game frame (+x forward, +y up, +z right), metres; axes are unit vectors and every angle follows the right-hand rule. fork: FORK has its origin on the steering axis at the top of the steering head and no rotation of its own; a turn of +a about rig.fork.axis (up the raked steering axis) steers the front wheel to the LEFT (counter-clockwise seen from above, the same sense as a wheel pivot rotation.y), so use a = -sim.steerAngle. FORK_LOWER (sliders, fender, disc, caliper, hub_F) is a child of FORK with its origin on the front axle; move it by the front suspension compression (metres, + = wheel up) along rig.fork.lower.axis. The steering mount sits on the fork tubes plane (the stock bar's caps on the tubes), 35 mm ahead of the axis: parent the steering part to FORK and do not spin it about its own origin. swingarm: SWINGARM pivots about rig.swingarm.axis through its pivot; +a raises the rear axle (bump): a = asin(rise / length). shocks: SHOCK_UPPER_* are fixed on the frame (origin = top eye), SHOCK_LOWER_* ride on the swingarm (origin = bottom eye); both have local +y (game) along the shock from the bottom eye to the top eye at rest; to keep them in line aim the upper's -y at the lower eye and the lower's +y at the upper eye (optional: the lower half slides inside the upper's shroud either way). stand: STAND is modelled down (foot on the ground with the bike upright); fold it for riding by +fold_deg about rig.stand.axis through rig.stand.pivot. needles turn about their local +y (game) = Blender local +Z by deg_full * reading. Mounts with "on" are children of that object in the GLB (pos/quat here are at rest, in the frame space).

fork.children: FORK_LOWER, N_speed, N_rpm and the mounts steering, headlight, mirror_L, mirror_R, ignition, horn; FORK_LOWER carries hub_F and bumperFront

stand.note: modelled down, its foot pad just clear of the ground with the bike upright

swingarm.children: SHOCK_LOWER_L, SHOCK_LOWER_R and the mount hub_R

units: metres, game frame (+x forward, +y up, +z right)
